Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities,

to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS: 6845 -1972 




Indian Standard 



( Reaffirmed 2006 ) 



SPECIFICATION FOR 
WIRE BASKET FOR SCREENING BALLAST 



1. Scope — Lays down the requirements for wire baskets for screening ballast. 

2. Dimensions 



TACK WELD 




All dimensions in millimetres. 



2.1 Tolerances — Tolerances on untoieranced dimensions shall be according to the best prevalent 
manufacturing practices. 

3. Material — The main body of the wire basket shall be woven from 2*80 mm galvanized 
wire conforming to IS : 280-1962 'Specification for miid steel wire for general engineering purposes 
(revised) '. The handle and frame shall be manufactured from galvanized wire of 10 mm diameter 
conforming to IS : 280-1962. 

4. Construction — The handles shall be fitted opposite each other on two sides and shall swing the 
basket freely on to the frame. The ends of the handles shall be suitably welded. The frame rod shall 
be suitably tack welded as shown in the figure. The mesh size of the basket shall be 10x10 mm, 
Max. 

5. Marking — The baskets shall be suitably marked with the manufacturer's name, initials or recog- 
nized trade-mark. 

5.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution, New Delhi 1. 

6. Sampling — Unless otherwise agreed to between the supplier and the purchaser, the procedure 
given in IS : 2500 ( Part I )-1963 'Sampling inspection tables: Part I Inspection by attributes and by 
count of defects ' shall be followed for sampling inspection. The sampling plan for various charac- 
teristics shall be as given in 6.1. 



Adopted 15 February 1973 



April 1973, ISI 



INDIAN STANDARDS INSTITUTION 

MANAK BHAVAN, 9 BAHADUR SHAH ZAFAR MARG 

NEW DELHI I 




IS: 6845- 1973 

6.1 For dimensions and construction, sampling plan with inspection level III and acceptable quality 
level (AQL) 25 percent given in Tables 1 and 2 of IS : 2500 (Part I )-1963, shall be followed. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard lays down the requirements for wire baskets for screening ballasts mostly 
employed by the Indian Railways. These baskets are employed for handling ballast in railway 
track construction and maintenance. While preparing this standard, assistance has been derived from 
the Central Railway Drawing No. CM(W) BB/5671 ' Wire basket for screening ballast '. 



Printed at Printograph, New Delhi S, India
